framework_control_model: Consumer privacy rights, notices, disclosure, deletion, correction, opt-out, and sensitive information controls.
framework_evidence_model: Consumer request intake, verification, fulfillment, denial rationale, disclosure inventory, opt-out, and retention evidence.
assessment_notes: Link each privacy finding to the consumer right, request state, and system inventory evidence.

framework_control_model: AWS account, IAM, logging, monitoring, and networking configuration recommendations.
framework_evidence_model: Cloud configuration state, API settings, audit logs, monitoring rules, and remediation evidence.
assessment_notes: Treat benchmark recommendations as technical configuration evidence, not broad governance coverage.

framework_control_model: Secure configuration recommendations across operating systems, cloud services, databases, and applications.
framework_evidence_model: Configuration state, benchmark scan result, exception, remediation, and sampled asset evidence.
assessment_notes: Always retain the product benchmark name and version with evidence.

framework_control_model: Prioritized cyber defense safeguards organized by Implementation Group.
framework_evidence_model: Asset, software, vulnerability, access, logging, malware, data protection, and incident response evidence by safeguard.
assessment_notes: Use Implementation Group and safeguard granularity when prioritizing coverage gaps.

framework_control_model: Amazon EKS configuration recommendations.
framework_evidence_model: EKS cluster settings, IAM integration, logging, network policy, encryption, and node configuration evidence.
assessment_notes: Bind evidence to the EKS benchmark version and the sampled cluster mode.

framework_control_model: Google Kubernetes Engine configuration recommendations.
framework_evidence_model: GKE cluster settings, workload identity, logging, network policy, private cluster, and release channel evidence.
assessment_notes: Bind evidence to the GKE benchmark version and the sampled cluster mode.

framework_control_model: GitHub organization and repository secure configuration recommendations.
framework_evidence_model: Organization settings, repository access, branch protection, secret scanning, audit log, and collaborator evidence.
assessment_notes: Scope evidence to the GitHub organization, repository class, and benchmark version.

framework_control_model: Google Workspace tenant and application secure configuration recommendations.
framework_evidence_model: Admin configuration, identity, group, device, sharing, audit log, and application setting evidence.
assessment_notes: Scope evidence to tenant, organizational unit, and benchmark version.

framework_control_model: Kubernetes control plane, node, policy, and workload hardening recommendations.
framework_evidence_model: Cluster configuration, admission policy, RBAC, audit logging, network policy, and kubelet setting evidence.
assessment_notes: Scope evidence by Kubernetes distribution and benchmark version before claiming conformance.

framework_control_model: Outcome-oriented cybersecurity performance goals for critical infrastructure and enterprise risk reduction.
framework_evidence_model: Asset inventory, account security, vulnerability, logging, backup, incident response, and third-party risk evidence.
assessment_notes: Treat CISA goals as operating outcomes, not audit clauses, unless mapped to a formal assessment program.

framework_control_model: Policy areas for protecting Criminal Justice Information across governance, access, identification, authentication, audit, encryption, media, incident response, and mobile access.
framework_evidence_model: Agency agreement, security addendum, personnel screening, access authorization, MFA, audit log, encryption, media protection, incident response, and training evidence.
assessment_notes: Preserve agency role, CJI scope, user population, system boundary, and policy-area context before asserting coverage.

framework_control_model: Cybersecurity maturity model for Federal Contract Information and Controlled Unclassified Information protection levels.
framework_evidence_model: System security plan, assessment objective evidence, control implementation, asset scope, CUI handling, POA&M, policy, procedure, and technical configuration evidence.
assessment_notes: Bind evidence to CMMC level, assessment scope, CUI environment, and the underlying NIST SP 800-171 practice where applicable.

framework_control_model: Cloud control domains for governance, risk, compliance, identity, infrastructure, data, application, interoperability, and assurance programs.
framework_evidence_model: Cloud service scope, shared-responsibility statement, policy, configuration state, identity control, data protection, logging, vulnerability, supplier, and assurance evidence.
assessment_notes: Preserve cloud service model, deployment model, tenant boundary, shared-responsibility owner, and mapped CCM domain when asserting coverage.

framework_control_model: Internal AI governance controls for model, data, vendor, risk, and monitoring workflows.
framework_evidence_model: AI inventory, risk assessment, policy, approval, evaluation, monitoring, and exception evidence.
assessment_notes: Use as a product operating control pack and map outward to ISO 42001 or the EU AI Act when required.

framework_control_model: Internal finance and revenue operations control pack.
framework_evidence_model: Approval, reconciliation, access, change, exception, and close-process evidence.
assessment_notes: Use as an operating-control layer before external SOX or finance-framework mapping exists.

framework_control_model: Internal continuity, incident, service, vendor, and resilience control pack.
framework_evidence_model: Incident timeline, continuity test, backup, service health, dependency, vendor, and corrective-action evidence.
assessment_notes: Map outward to DORA, ISO 22301, SOC 2 availability, or NIST contingency controls where needed.

framework_control_model: Internal organizational governance, people, ownership, and accountability control pack.
framework_evidence_model: Owner assignment, policy approval, training, exception, review cadence, role, and governance evidence.
assessment_notes: Use for owner and accountability coverage before mapping to formal external clauses.

framework_control_model: Internal revenue operations, customer lifecycle, billing, and support control pack.
framework_evidence_model: Approval, entitlement, billing, support, change, exception, and customer-impact evidence.
assessment_notes: Use as an operating control pack and map outward to customer assurance requirements as needed.

framework_control_model: Digital operational resilience requirements for financial entities, including ICT risk management, incident reporting, resilience testing, third-party risk, and information sharing.
framework_evidence_model: ICT risk register, resilience strategy, incident classification, reporting records, testing program, third-party contract, exit plan, and remediation evidence.
assessment_notes: Preserve financial-entity role, ICT service scope, materiality, incident date, testing scope, and third-party dependency when linking evidence to DORA controls.

framework_control_model: Risk-based AI system obligations, governance, documentation, transparency, monitoring, and human oversight.
framework_evidence_model: AI inventory, risk classification, technical documentation, data governance, transparency notice, human oversight, logging, and post-market monitoring evidence.
assessment_notes: Evidence must preserve AI system role, risk class, provider/deployer responsibility, and effective date.

framework_control_model: Federal cloud authorization baselines derived from NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 with FedRAMP parameters, templates, and continuous monitoring expectations.
framework_evidence_model: System security plan, control implementation statement, assessment procedure results, POA&M, vulnerability scan, continuous monitoring, authorization boundary, and inherited-control evidence.
assessment_notes: Keep FedRAMP authorization package evidence separate from plain NIST 800-53 control evidence because parameters, inheritance, and continuous monitoring obligations differ.

framework_control_model: Data protection principles, lawful processing, data subject rights, controller/processor duties, security, and breach requirements.
framework_evidence_model: Records of processing, legal basis, data subject request handling, DPIA, processor agreement, security control, and breach notification evidence.
assessment_notes: Article 30 records and Article 32 security evidence should be separated from policy-only assertions.

framework_authority: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services
framework_control_model: HIPAA Security, Privacy, and Breach Notification requirements for protected health information.
framework_evidence_model: Administrative, physical, and technical safeguard evidence plus policies, risk analysis, access controls, audit controls, and breach procedures.
assessment_notes: Keep addressable implementation specifications distinct from required specifications and document rationale for alternatives.

framework_control_model: Essential cybersecurity control set for HITRUST assurance.
framework_evidence_model: Control implementation, policy, procedure, sampled operation, and corrective-action evidence.
assessment_notes: Keep HITRUST requirement statements and assessment-object evidence traceable to licensed source materials.

framework_control_model: Information security management system requirements with Annex A control references.
framework_evidence_model: ISMS scope, risk treatment, Statement of Applicability, control operation, monitoring, and management review evidence.
assessment_notes: Pair requirement evidence from ISO 27001 with implementation guidance from the ISO 27002 control catalog when available.

framework_control_model: Privacy information management extension to ISO 27001 and ISO 27002.
framework_evidence_model: PII controller and processor governance, privacy roles, processing records, notices, consent, and data subject request evidence.
assessment_notes: Preserve where still contractually referenced, but prefer the current ISO 27701 edition when building new evidence packs.

framework_control_model: Privacy information management system requirements and guidance.
framework_evidence_model: PIMS scope, lawful processing, privacy risk treatment, data subject rights, processor management, and privacy control evidence.
assessment_notes: Use this as the preferred ISO privacy source for new privacy evidence profiles.

framework_control_model: AI management system requirements for responsible development, deployment, and operation.
framework_evidence_model: AI system inventory, impact assessment, risk treatment, model governance, monitoring, human oversight, and supplier evidence.
assessment_notes: Treat AI evidence as management-system evidence plus runtime model and data governance proof.

framework_control_model: Cybersecurity risk-management and incident-reporting duties for essential and important entities.
framework_evidence_model: Governance approval, risk-management measures, incident notification, supply-chain security, business continuity, vulnerability handling, encryption, access control, and training evidence.
assessment_notes: Preserve entity class, member-state implementation context, incident reporting clock, and management-body accountability when evaluating evidence.

framework_control_model: Security and privacy controls organized by control family with baselines and overlays.
framework_evidence_model: Control implementation statements, assessment objectives, examined artifacts, interviews, tests, and inherited control evidence.
assessment_notes: Pair with NIST SP 800-53A Rev. 5 assessment procedures when defining exact evidence sufficiency.

framework_control_model: AI risk management functions organized by Govern, Map, Measure, and Manage for trustworthy AI risk practices.
framework_evidence_model: AI system context, stakeholder impact analysis, risk register, governance decision, evaluation record, monitoring signal, incident response, model change, and residual-risk evidence.
assessment_notes: Preserve AI system lifecycle stage, actor role, intended use, affected population, measurement method, and residual-risk decision when evaluating evidence.

framework_control_model: Outcome-oriented cybersecurity core organized by Govern, Identify, Protect, Detect, Respond, and Recover functions with categories and subcategories.
framework_evidence_model: Current profile, target profile, tier rationale, risk register, governance record, asset inventory, protective control, detection, response, recovery, and improvement evidence.
assessment_notes: Treat CSF evidence as outcome and profile evidence; map to prescriptive control frameworks before claiming implementation sufficiency.

framework_control_model: Trustworthy email guidance for domain authentication, mail transport security, and message-content security.
framework_evidence_model: Sending domain, DNS mail-authentication records, DNS mail-routing records, related mail-security DNS records, validation timestamp, and remediation evidence.
assessment_notes: Use for email-domain authentication and related mail transport evidence; do not treat it as cloud shared-responsibility evidence. Keep message-content protection as separate evidence unless a source supplies it.

framework_control_model: Cardholder data environment requirements and testing procedures.
framework_evidence_model: CDE scope, network segmentation, secure configuration, vulnerability management, access control, logging, testing, and policy evidence.
assessment_notes: Preserve for historical mappings, but prefer PCI DSS v4.0.1 for new evidence work.

framework_control_model: Cardholder data environment requirements and testing procedures.
framework_evidence_model: CDE scope, network segmentation, secure configuration, vulnerability management, access control, logging, testing, and policy evidence.
assessment_notes: Keep requirement and testing procedure evidence distinct; testing evidence usually needs sampled systems and dates.

framework_control_model: Service-provider self-assessment questionnaire aligned to PCI DSS requirements.
framework_evidence_model: Attestation responses, requirement evidence, service provider scope, compensating controls, and management sign-off.
assessment_notes: Treat SAQ rows as attestation evidence linked to PCI DSS requirement evidence.

framework_control_model: Trust services criteria and points of focus for service organization controls.
framework_evidence_model: Control design and operating effectiveness evidence across security, availability, confidentiality, processing integrity, and privacy criteria.
assessment_notes: Use inquiry, observation, inspection, and reperformance evidence matched to the asserted trust service criterion.

framework_control_model: Internal grouping for U.S. state privacy obligations.
framework_evidence_model: Consumer rights, disclosure inventory, opt-out, retention, purpose limitation, and processor/vendor evidence.
assessment_notes: Use jurisdiction-specific statute rows before claiming legal conformance.
